an9.42:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā ānando kosambiyaṃ viharati ghositārāme.
an9.42:1.2: athakho āyasmā udāyi yenāyasmā ānando tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā ānandena saddhiṃ sammodi
an9.42:1.3: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā udāyi āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavoca
an9.42:3.1: katamo āvuso sambādho katamo sambādhe okāsādhigamo vutto bhagavatāti.
an9.42:3.2: pañcime āvuso kāmaguṇā sambādho vutto bhagavatā
an9.42:3.4: cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasañhitā rajaniyā
an9.42:3.8: kāyaviññeyyā phoṭṭhabbā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasañhitā rajaniyā
an9.42:3.9: ime kho āvuso pañca kāmaguṇā sambādho vutto bhagavatā.
an9.42:4.1: idhāvuso bhikkhu vivicceva kāmehi …pe… paṭhamajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharati
an9.42:4.2: ettāvatāpi kho āvuso sambādhe okāsādhigamo vutto bhagavatā pariyāyena
an9.42:4.5: yadeva tattha vitakkavicārā aniruddhā honti ayamettha sambādho.
an9.42:5.1: puna caparaṃ āvuso bhikkhu vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā …pe… dutiyajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharati
an9.42:5.2: ettāvatāpi kho āvuso sambādhe okāsādhigamo vutto bhagavatā pariyāyena
an9.42:5.5: yadeva tattha pīti aniruddhā hoti ayamettha sambādho.
an9.42:6.1: puna caparaṃ āvuso bhikkhu pītiyā ca virāgā …pe… tatiyajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharati
an9.42:6.2: ettāvatāpi kho āvuso sambādhe okāsādhigamo vutto bhagavatā pariyāyena
an9.42:6.5: yadeva tattha upekkhāsukhaṃ aniruddhaṃ hoti ayamettha sambādho.
an9.42:7.1: puna caparaṃ āvuso bhikkhu sukhassa ca pahānā …pe… catutthajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharati
an9.42:7.2: ettāvatāpi kho āvuso sambādhe okāsādhigamo vutto bhagavatā pariyāyena
an9.42:7.5: yadeva tattha rūpasaññā aniruddhā hoti ayamettha sambādho.
an9.42:8.1: puna caparaṃ āvuso bhikkhu sabbaso rūpasaññānaṃ samatikkamā paṭighasaññānaṃ atthaṅgamā nānattasaññānaṃ amanasikārā ananto ākāsoti ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati
an9.42:8.2: ettāvatāpi kho āvuso sambādhe okāsādhigamo vutto bhagavatā pariyāyena
an9.42:8.5: yadeva tattha ākāsānañcāyatanasaññā aniruddhā hoti ayamettha sambādho.
an9.42:9.1: puna caparaṃ āvuso bhikkhu sabbaso ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma anantaṃ viññāṇanti viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati
an9.42:9.2: ettāvatāpi kho āvuso sambādhe okāsādhigamo vutto bhagavatā pariyāyena
an9.42:9.5: yadeva tattha viññāṇañcāyatanasaññā aniruddhā hoti ayamettha sambādho.
an9.42:10.1: puna caparaṃ āvuso bhikkhu sabbaso viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma natthi kiñcīti ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati
an9.42:10.2: ettāvatāpi kho āvuso sambādhe okāsādhigamo vutto bhagavatā pariyāyena
an9.42:10.5: yadeva tattha ākiñcaññāyatanasaññā aniruddhā hoti ayamettha sambādho.
an9.42:11.1: puna caparaṃ āvuso bhikkhu sabbaso ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ samatikkamma nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati
an9.42:11.2: ettāvatāpi kho āvuso sambādhe okāsādhigamo vutto bhagavatā pariyāyena
an9.42:11.5: yadeva tattha nevasaññānāsaññāyatanasaññā aniruddhā hoti ayamettha sambādho.
an9.42:12.1: puna caparaṃ āvuso bhikkhu sabbaso nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ samatikkamma saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ upasampajja viharati paññāyapassa disvā āsavā parikkhīṇā honti
an9.42:12.2: ettāvatāpi kho āvuso sambādhe okāsādhigamo vutto bhagavatā nippariyāyenāti. 43
